import numpy as np

def r(x):
    return float(x) * 0.5

def R(y_orig, y_new):
    e_orig = abs(float(y_orig) - 1.0)
    e_new = abs(float(y_new) - 1.0)
    if e_orig < 1e-15:
        return e_new < 1e-12
    ratio = e_new / e_orig
    order = np.log(1.0 / ratio) / np.log(2.0)
    return abs(order - 2.0) <= 0.2
